idea: Count word frequencies in a single pass with case folding
strategy: algorithmic: replace an O(n^2) pattern with a hash-based or sorted approach
rationale: words.count(w) inside a loop over unique words is O(unique * n). One pass with a dict is O(n).
reasoning: Single pass instead of repeated count(). Lowercasing normalizes keys (this silently changes behavior; the harness should catch it).
